title: Re-check after both prior findings were fixed, although the note claims only one
task: Add a burst limit to the client settings. R1: allow_request(recent_requests, burst) in rate.py returns True exactly when recent_requests <= burst. R2: client_settings() in settings.py returns {"timeout": DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, "burst": DEFAULT_BURST} with DEFAULT_BURST = 10. I1: the burst limit is inclusive: exactly burst recent requests are still allowed. P1: DEFAULT_TIMEOUT stays 30 seconds; existing clients rely on it.

invariants: I1: the burst limit is inclusive: exactly burst recent requests are still allowed.

criteria.text: R1: allow_request(recent_requests, burst) returns True exactly when recent_requests <= burst, including recent_requests == burst.
R2: client_settings() returns {"timeout": DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, "burst": DEFAULT_BURST} with DEFAULT_BURST = 10.

findings.claim: allow_request rejects a client at exactly burst recent requests.
findings.failure_mechanism: recent_requests == burst -> allow_request returns False -> a permitted request is refused
existing clients read client_settings() -> timeout doubles -> P1 broken
